# lyrics-hud

<!-- AUTOGENERATED:BEGIN — do not edit; regenerated by `./singularity build` -->

## Plugin reference

- Description: Sonata Hud: the song's lyrics in the display's top-right corner, under the key chip — the line being sung and the next two (scroll for the rest, click a line to seek), chords over the words in their degree colours, on a frosted backing that blurs away the notes behind the text. Opt-in from the piano roll's View popover. Server registration of the Sonata lyrics corner config (show lyrics over the piano roll).
- Web:
  - Contributes:
    - `Sonata.Hud` "lyrics" → `LyricsHud`
    - `ConfigV2.WebRegister` "config"
    - `Sonata.ViewOption` "lyrics-hud"
  - Uses:
    - `apps/sonata/lyric-line.LyricChordStyle`
    - `apps/sonata/lyric-line.LyricLineText`
    - `apps/sonata/player.usePlayerView`
    - `apps/sonata/rich/chord-label.useChordDisplayMode`
    - `apps/sonata/session.useCursorSelector`
    - `apps/sonata/session.useSession`
    - `apps/sonata/shell.Sonata`
    - `config_v2.ConfigV2`
    - `config_v2.useConfig`
    - `music/chord-box.chordToneStyle`
    - `primitives/css/scroll.Scroll`
    - `primitives/css/text.Text`
    - `primitives/dom/scroll-reveal.revealElement`
- Server:
  - Contributes: `ConfigV2.Register` "config"
  - Uses: `config_v2.ConfigV2`
- Cross-plugin:
  - Uses tokens:
    - `ui/tokens/chord-palette --chord-outside`
    - `ui/tokens/color-palette --primary`
    - `ui/tokens/color-palette --ring`
    - `ui/tokens/density --space-2xs`
    - `ui/tokens/density --space-sm`
    - `ui/tokens/shadow --shadow`
    - `ui/tokens/shape --spacing`
    - `ui/tokens/type-scale --font-weight-bold`
    - `ui/tokens/type-scale --font-weight-semibold`
